text.en:
9th. MARCH, 2006 No. S 35

TELECOMMUNICATION SUCCESSOR COMPANY ORDER, 2001 (S 37/01)

ORDER UNDER SECTION 2 In exercise of the power conferred by section 2, the Minister of Finance hereby appoints the 1st. day of April, 2006 as the succession date for the purposes of section 3 of the Telecommunication Successor Company Order, 2001. Dated this 4th. day of Safar, 1427 Hijriah corresponding to the 4th. day of March, 2006.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

MINISTER OF FINANCE, BRUNEI DARUSSALAM.
